notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is the tnlandforms list (name, county, elevation, coordinates). That list's note says names for towers 73 and up are the compiler's own, so 'cataula' is probably a locality label, not a documented tower name. Its elevation column has no unit label; 710 is read as feet because the record's 216.4 m matches it. No source found on build date, design, staffing, status or access. Two searches and the Harris County material turned up nothing for this tower; the 1955 Columbus Ledger item on easternuslookouts (Harris Tower, William Mountain Tower) is about other towers and is not used. Other Harris towers on the list (GA023, GA034, GA196, GA202) lie elsewhere and must not be merged. The Savannah article was read from a web.archive.org copy because savannahnow.com returned 403. Suggest checking Georgia Forestry Commission tower records and Harris County or Columbus newspapers for this site.
